notes: Named in line 56 as the prior-art class bestimmte Benzoylcyclohexandione said to possess herbicidal properties, and again in line 58 as die bekannten Verbindungen; the two mentions are merged into this one record. The printed German is a plural class term covering a Markush family, not one specific compound, so resolved is false and the German as printed is kept in aliases. The substituent descriptions in the same sentences (substituierter Phenoxymethylrest, heterocyclischer Rest, and the bridge atoms oxygen, sulfur and nitrogen) are R-group fragments and are not emitted as compounds. The patent numbers JP-A 08 020554, JP-A 02 00222, WO 99/10327, WO 99/07688 and WO 99/03845 are citations, not compounds.
